method: Native CUA keyboard input, accessibility observations and screenshots of the optimized owned app. Screenshots were inspected in-session; no screenshot files are published.
observations: Limited audition label is visible beside Play edit / Space and Monitor / :monitor below the dominant picture. Original and Edit durations are separate. Original remains pinned left; selected beat and focus use lavender, cursor yellow.

Space started native playback; accessibility observed sequence frame150 at boundary149. Playback subsequently ended at exactly187/187, selected/revealed the final seven-frame Hold, and displayed sequence frame187 with Original counter119. No playback failure appeared.
12h from final boundary moved to boundary175 and displayed sequence frame176; selected fourth Hold135..180.
:monitor25% (entered with a separating space) showed Monitor25.0% and slider0.25 while Saved remained visible. :monitor12.5% restored the starting setting before the next playback.

gg returned to start. A second playback showed frame153 at boundary152. After returning to start, immediate Space then Space left boundary0/frame1 and stopped preparation; this is cancellation evidence, not a separately observed midstream pause.

? opened the readable Keys guide with the updated limiter/full-mix explanation and monitor binding. PageDown visibly scrolled to structural commands. Escape closed it. Tab focused Inspector; ShiftTab restored Viewer.
Command-Q exited the owned process. The entire logical SQLite dump is unchanged.
limitations: No acoustic recording or listening assessment, route/sleep/wake stress, physical non-US keyboard, CJK IME or VoiceOver run.
The CUA accessibility snapshot did not expose help text in its truncated tree; help appearance and paging were verified visually. No accessibility conformance claim.

Current application still omits full effects/mix/export and broader product requirements. This review compares the implemented layout with the existing single-source target, not every proposed target feature.
